meaning: Each acceptance_id names a future source-parity obligation, not an existing executable test or a passing result.
required_completion_evidence: Rust implementation commit and symbol or artifact path in the assigned module
Executable Rust regression identifier or explicitly justified documentation/artifact review
Passing command output linked to the acceptance ID, including platform and relevant configuration
Review of the referenced complete SDK source, not only its signature or literal schema
Explicit approved divergence for any intentionally changed behavior

category_obligations.apis: Preserve the referenced public contract or internal behavior needed by public consumers: field/tag/serialization semantics, signature intent, alias/member relationships, defaults, errors, cancellation, concurrency and ownership. Rust syntax need not mirror Go.
category_obligations.packages: Account for the package's files, exported API and host/internal boundaries in the proposed module and regress its candidate Go tests.
category_obligations.tools: Match tool name, description, complete input schema, runtime default/clamp behavior, results/errors, approval, timeout, permission and enablement semantics for applicable configurations. Dynamic adapters require host/MCP fixtures.
category_obligations.tool_parameters: Preserve property type, enum, requiredness, bounds and nested schema; distinguish JSON defaults, documented defaults and actual runtime defaults. Trace back to the parent tool.
category_obligations.capabilities: Exercise feature selection, disabled paths, host-only requirements and interactions with permissions. Follow verification_group_id to concrete candidate Go regressions; establish symbol-specific Rust assertions.
category_obligations.registrations: Verify the registration call or literal in its enclosing branch, with default, opted-in, disabled and permission-specific cases. A static occurrence is not an unconditional registration.
category_obligations.cli_flags: Match parsing, help, default initializer and environment precedence, validation, output/exit behavior and post-parse normalization. Distinguish Go standard flag behavior from explicit SDK registrations.
category_obligations.environment: Match key/expression, fallback, precedence and invalid/absent-value behavior without persisting credentials. Test production sites separately from test-only reads.
category_obligations.configuration: Translate the complete configuration/constructor/registry function and its referenced types and helpers; test resolved effective configuration rather than guessing from field names.
category_obligations.defaults: Preserve the literal and surrounding override/normalization logic; evaluate environment-dependent or computed defaults in fixtures.
category_obligations.tests: Port or explicitly replace the referenced Go entry point, including live/skip gates, failure assertions and platform guards. This inventory did not run it.
category_obligations.subtests: Port the enclosing table/callback and data-dependent cases; one static Run call is not one runtime test case.
category_obligations.examples: Provide runnable idiomatic Rust usage for the file's demonstrated capabilities, retaining credential/live-test prerequisites where applicable.
category_obligations.evals_and_automation: Preserve eval tasks/assertions, audit fixtures, scoring, adapters, workflow gates and script behavior, or record a reviewed replacement. No eval has been executed by this baseline.
category_obligations.os_constraints: Exercise each supported build constraint or document an intentional unsupported platform with equivalent safe failure behavior.
category_obligations.os_runtime_checks: Verify both sides of runtime platform conditionals on applicable OSes, especially confinement, PTY/process lifecycle and fallback behavior.
category_obligations.artifacts: Review and migrate the complete non-Go file contract, configuration/fixture contents, dependencies, legal notices or documentation as appropriate. File-level coverage does not imply semantic normalization.
category_obligations.files: Retain traceability from the exact source hash to migrated behavior or an explicit reviewed non-code/artifact disposition.
category_obligations.verification_groups: Review all listed concrete Go regression references, fill explicit coverage gaps and attach executable Rust tests. Module association is not measured symbol coverage.
